title: Adventuring Time
body:
You get points for exploring various things:
- 10 points for finding a new biome
- 25 points for entering a new dimension
- 5 points for finding a new entity type (there must be 2 of this entity nearby to count)
- 5 points for discovering a new [Point of Interest](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Point_of_Interest) type (e.g. bed, bell, nether portal, etc)
- 15 points for entering a new structure

Your score is displayed on the side of the screen.
